name: Costello's Ace Hardware
status: excluded: franchise/chain - one branch of a multi-state Ace Hardware franchise group with dozens of stores and a shared corporate site
what_they_do: Ace Hardware franchise store selling hardware, paint (Benjamin Moore), keys and key-fob programming, and household goods; part of Costello's Ace, a chain with locations across NJ, NY, PA, MD and VA, plus a separate Costello's Hearth & Spa brand.
customers: Homeowners and contractors locally; buying decisions and web presence are managed at the chain level

size_signals.signal: Store locator lists dozens of Costello's Ace locations across NJ, NY, PA, MD and VA (Abington PA, Appomattox VA, Baldwin Harbor NY, Bel Air MD, Bellmore NY, Bernardsville NJ, Caldwell NJ, Cedar Knolls NJ ...)
Chain-wide e-commerce hand-off to acehardware.com and a 'Choose My Store' store-selector pattern
Review quotes on the store page mention key programming and paint selection

listing.rating: 4.2 (per a directory aggregation, not verified on Google Maps in this session)

website_review.primary_cta: Chain-level store selector and Ace Hardware e-commerce hand-off
website_review.trust_signals: Corporate branding, Costello's Cares page, local ads, store-specific pages
website_review.out_of_date_signs: n/a - not assessed in depth because the business is excluded
website_review.search_basics: n/a - corporate site serves all locations; local SEO decisions sit with the chain
top_issues: Excluded from this study: a single store inside a multi-state franchise chain does not fit the independent-business brief

agent_readiness.notes: Not assessed - excluded as a franchise/chain location; any website, schema or booking work happens at corporate level rather than at this store.
